name: Northampton Valley Country Club
sourceLabel: Official Northampton Valley course overview and scorecard
cardNote: The club’s current course overview supplies four tee rows, par, stroke indexes and hole-by-hole descriptions. Every front, back and total sum reconciles. Ratings/slopes are not printed on that source and are left unset. All 18 numbered mapped routes match the official par sequence; confirm the day’s tee markers and flag positions on arrival.
